## AddConnectedAccount

```go
func (s *ConnectedAccountsService) AddConnectedAccount(ctx context.Context, body *AddConnectedAccountRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*AddConnectedAccountResponse, error)
```

`POST /connected_accounts` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Add a connected account**

Creates a new connected account for the authenticated tenant.

The `creds` field must be a Base64-encoded RSA-encrypted credential blob.
Use `GET /connected_accounts/credentials/public_key` to retrieve the public key for encryption.

The `providerType` is derived server-side from the `providerId` — callers do not supply it.

Endpoint Permission: Editor, Admin, Non-Signing Admin.

**Request body:** [`*AddConnectedAccountRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#AddConnectedAccountRequest)

**Returns:** [`*AddConnectedAccountResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#AddConnectedAccountResponse)

## UpdateConnectedAccountCredentials

```go
func (s *ConnectedAccountsService) UpdateConnectedAccountCredentials(ctx context.Context, accountID string, body *UpdateConnectedAccountCredentialsRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*UpdateConnectedAccountCredentialsResponse, error)
```

`POST /connected_accounts/{accountId}/credentials` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Update connected account credentials**

Replace the API credentials (secret + API key) of a connected account.

Credentials belong to an API key, which can back a single account or an entire hierarchy.
Updating them affects all accounts sharing that key, so the endpoint returns an array of modified accounts.

The `creds` field must be a Base64-encoded RSA-encrypted credential blob; use
`GET /connected_accounts/credentials/public_key` to retrieve the public key for encryption.
Both `creds` and `apiKey` are mandatory.

Validation against the exchange is synchronous, but the update itself is **pending mobile
approval** — the existing credentials stay live until the change is approved, so none of the
affected accounts are disconnected in the meantime.

Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accountID` | path | `string` | yes | The unique identifier of the connected account whose API key credentials are being replaced. |

**Request body:** [`*UpdateConnectedAccountCredentialsRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#UpdateConnectedAccountCredentialsRequest)

**Returns:** [`*UpdateConnectedAccountCredentialsResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#UpdateConnectedAccountCredentialsResponse)
